title: Dyadic Synthesis Filter Bank
text: Reconstruct signals from subbands with smaller bandwidths and slower sample rates or compute inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT), 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Filter} sets Type of filter used in filter bank; {Filter order [synthesis / analysis]} sets the wavelet order for synthesis filter stage, {Wavelet order}, {Lowpass FIR filter coefficients}, {Highpass FIR filter coefficients}, {Number of levels} sets the number of filter bank levels, {Tree structure} sets the structure of filter and {Input}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filter
params.values: Type of filter used in filter bank User-defined (default) | Haar | Daubechies | Symlets | Coiflets | Biorthogonal | Reverse Biorthogonal | Discrete Meyer

params.name: Number of levels
params.values: Number of filter bank levels 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Tree structure
params.values: Structure of filter bank Asymmetric (default) | Symmetric
